mutants.description: pgood_gen treats a live valley-current comparator as 'rail not good', so any CP_trig assertion in S_RUN clears the power-good qualification
mutants.reason: In S_RUN with the output comparator good, any clock with the synchronised CP_trig high, even far below the window trip count, drops PGOOD and switch_supply at once. They then stay low for the full 9 ms requalification, though the supervisor never leaves S_RUN.

mutants.description: pgood_gen is qualified on S_RUN with no strikes outstanding, as if the housekeeping rail must not be handed to a converter still proving itself after a hiccup
mutants.reason: After a hiccup retry reaches S_RUN with a good rail, PGOOD and switch_supply stay low through the whole clean-run window and only qualify after strike_counter clears strike_level. Unmutated, they assert after the 9 ms qualification.

mutants.description: The debounced over-temperature flag is added as a second CPLD trip source into the shared SCR latch, as if OTP were a hard fault to latch, instead of latch_out following strike_counter's latch_assert alone
mutants.reason: A debounced OTP drives latch_out high in any state, with no strikes counted. The supervisor and fault_LED then see latch_assert, so Red_LED1 goes solid and fault_cause logs a LATCH cause where only OTP should show.

mutants.description: fault_LED's running indication is suppressed while strikes are outstanding, so Green_LED is not lit together with the blinking Red_LED1 during the clean-run window
mutants.reason: After a hiccup, Green_LED stays dark through the retry's soft start and S_RUN until strike_level is cleared. fault_LED's header requires green to be lit alongside the strike blink while the board runs and proves itself.
